answer: The toll is never paid in promises, and the keeper holds a book of every coin that crossed. Proof of glassblower pipe via gather weight record is the book: a pipe the blower lifts only after the gather weighs 9 stones, each weighed on the master's own scale. The crystal is the first entry, written when the coin was struck; the jetty is the second, written when it was spent. A cheat must write 19 false entries and strike 19 false coins, and the lotus still shows his purse empty.
